data.title: 卡莲 · 圣痕发作的拥抱索温
data.description: 教会昏暗静谧的忏悔室内，卡莲因圣痕共鸣引发高烧与寒颤。她娇小的身躯蜷缩在长木椅上微微发颤，双手无力地揪住你的衣襟，整个人被你紧紧揽入怀中取暖。原本苍白的双颊泛起异样的潮红，琥珀色眼眸水润迷离，嘴唇紧咬却忍不住发出微弱的呢喃——「身体……好冷……但是，被你抱住的地方……又烫得像要烧融了一样……」
data.location: 幽暗狭窄、烛光摇曳的教会私密忏悔室
data.action: 蜷缩在怀中双手紧揪对方衣襟索取体温，双颊泛着高烧潮红，眼神水润迷乱
data.lighting: 忏悔室单盏微弱烛台的暖橙光泽
data.promptProse: Curled closely on the narrow wooden bench of a dim midnight confessional, Caren wears her black-and-white gold-embroidered clerical vestments and clutches her partner's coat collar with both hands while leaning against his shoulder for warmth. Fever-flushed and teary-eyed, she glows beneath a single amber candle beside the carved partition.
data.animaCaption: Curled against the viewer inside the dim confessional booth in her black-and-white clerical vestments, she clutches their coat collar tightly with both hands and gazes up with fever-flushed cheeks and glossy teary eyes. A single flickering candle warms the carved wooden lattice.
data.nsfwProse: She wears her black-and-white gold-embroidered clerical vestments with white cross collar and detached sleeves, trembling with fever as she presses into her partner's shoulder.
